frozen_candidate_root_contribution: The root places one entity in the wake/track of another that precedes it, such that the trailing entity comes-behind-and-along the course of the leading reference. The subject (or the entity made-to-trail) is positioned AFTER a preceding reference-point and conforms its motion/sequence/course to it: a "going-after / coming-behind-in-the-track-of." Direction is fixed — the follower is behind, the followed goes before and sets the track.

internal_discovery.plain_explanation: Across all form-families the invariant is a leading reference X ahead and a trailing entity Y behind that moves in X's wake. (1) LITERAL MOTION/PURSUIT: Pharaoh "trailed after" the Israelites (10:90:5:2 fa-atbaʿahum; 20:78:1:2), the shooting-star "pursues/trails" the eavesdropping devil (15:18:5:2; 37:10:5:2 fa-atbaʿahu shihāb), "follow their backs/tracks" (15:65:6:2 wa-ttabiʿ adbārahum), "he took-to a route" (18:85:1:2/89/92 atbaʿa sababan), "you will be pursued" (26:52; 44:23 muttabaʿūn). (2) SEQUENCE/SUCCESSION: "the following blast trails it" (79:7:1:1 tatbaʿuhā al-rādifah), "We made the later ones follow" (77:17:2:1), "We made some follow others" one after another (23:44:11:2), two "consecutive/successive" months (4:92 & 58:4 mutatābiʿayn, form VI reciprocal = one-behind-another). (3) APPENDING/TRAILING A CONSEQUENCE (form IV causative): "do not follow-up (attach after) your spending with reproach" (2:262:9:1 yutbiʿūna...mannan), "charity that injury follows" (2:263:7:1 yatbaʿuhā adhan), "We made a curse trail them in this world" (11:60; 11:99; 28:42:1:2 atbaʿnāhum laʿnatan). (4) ALLEGIANCE / DISCIPLESHIP / ADHERENCE (the dominant form VIII cluster): fall in behind the Messenger (2:143:22:1; 7:157), the revelation (10:109; 6:106:1:1 ittabiʿ mā ūḥiya), guidance (2:38:10:1 tabiʿa hudāya; 20:123), Abraham's creed (16:123; 3:95), God's good-pleasure (5:16; 3:174) — versus falling in behind desires (hawā: 18:28; 25... 47:14; 38:26), conjecture (10:36; 53:23 yattabiʿūna illā al-ẓanna), Satan's "footsteps" (khuṭuwāt 2:168; 6:142; 24:21), a "path" (sabīl 31:15; ṣirāṭ 43:61). "Those who were-followed" (leaders) vs "those who followed" (2:166-167 uttubiʿū / ittabaʿū) makes the leader/trailer polarity explicit. (5) AGENTIVE NOUNS: "followers/dependents" (14:21; 40:47 tabaʿan), household "attendants" who trail (24:31 al-tābiʿīn), a "pursuer/claimant" who comes after to demand redress (17:69:22:1 tabīʿan). In every case, subtracting form and context leaves the same residue: Y in the track of a preceding X.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: FORM: I (tabiʿa) = bare "came-after/trailed" (14:36; 2:38; 79:7); IV (atbaʿa) = causative-directional "dispatch-after / make-trail / append-after" — adds a causer who sends or attaches the trailer (Pharaoh pursues; a curse is made to trail; reproach appended to charity); VIII (ittabaʿa) = reflexive-intensive "take-to-following," self-engaged adherence/pursuit (the dominant allegiance sense); VI (mutatābiʿ) = reciprocal "following-one-another" = consecutive; verbal noun ittibāʿ = the act of following (2:178; 4:157 ittibāʿa al-ẓanni); participle tābiʿ / noun tabaʿ / tabīʿ = the trailing party. PASSIVE (uttubiʿū, muttabaʿ) yields the LEADING reference. CONSTRUCTION: accusative object = the leading reference set as the track (Messenger, guidance, desires, footsteps, path, backs); explicit spatial objects adbār/āthār/sabīl/khuṭuwāt make the "in-the-track-of" literal; bi- (52:21 wa-ttabaʿathum...bi-īmān) keeps offspring as trailer. PARTICIPANTS (Pharaoh/star/believers/desires) and CONTEXT (narrative pursuit / eschatological summons / legal succession / creedal allegiance) select which surface reading, but the "come-behind-and-conform-to-the-preceding" residue is what remains after all four layers are removed.
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: The form-IV "append-after" cases where both terms are abstract and static — 2:262:9:1 "do not follow-up (yutbiʿūna) what you spent with reproach (mannan)" and 2:263:7:1 "charity that injury (adhan) follows." Here the "leading" element (the act of spending) is not itself moving and the "trailer" (reproach/injury) is not an agent tracking a path. Yet the residue survives cleanly: Y is placed AFTER X in sequence and issues from/attaches to it — the reproach is dispatched to come in the wake of the gift. This is the same directional "coming-after" seen literally in 79:7 (one blast trailing another) and 23:44 (messengers sent one-after-another), only with an abstract trailer. It reconciles without forcing: the before/after ordering and the wake-relation are intact.
internal_discovery.competing_hypothesis: The strongest alternative core is "OBEY / COMPLY WITH / ADHERE-TO (allegiance)", since the form-VIII majority reads as obedience to a guide or capitulation to desire. Internal evidence arbitrates decisively against it: (a) pure physical-pursuit occurrences (Pharaoh trailing, 10:90/20:78; the star pursuing the devil, 15:18/37:10; atbaʿa sababan, 18:85) carry NO compliance whatsoever — the pursued is an adversary/target, not an authority obeyed; (b) sequence occurrences (rādifah 79:7, consecutive months 4:92/58:4, curse made-to-trail 11:60, one-after-another 23:44) have no volitional obedience at all; (c) the text itself pairs the two roots as distinct — 20:90:14:2 "fa-ttabiʿūnī wa-aṭīʿū amrī" ("so FOLLOW me AND OBEY my command") lists following and obeying (ṭwʿ) as separate acts. "Obey" is therefore a contextual specialization of "falling in behind a guide," not the core; only the spatial/sequential "behind-in-the-track" residue covers 100% of occurrences.
internal_discovery.distinctiveness_note: Nearest neighbors and the boundary: (1) ṭwʿ (aṭāʿa/ṭāʿa) "obey/comply with a command" — pure will-conformity with no positional ordering; tbE adds the fixed "behind-in-track" geometry and covers non-obedience cases (pursuit, succession) that ṭwʿ cannot; the two co-occur as distinct (20:90). (2) qfw (qaffā, 57:27 qaffaynā) "send-in-succession upon the traces" — very close, but qfw foregrounds the nape/rear-trace of dispatching a successor; tbE foregrounds the trailer conforming its course. (3) ʿqb (ʿaqqaba, ʿāqibah) "come at the heel / follow with consequence" — centers the heel/aftermath; tbE centers track-conformity, not merely the heel. (4) slk/mšy/srā "go along / walk a path" — motion WITHOUT a preceding reference; tbE obligatorily requires a leading X whose track is adopted. (5) hdy "guide" is the converse pole (the one ahead setting the track); tbE is the trailing pole. FALSIFIABILITY: the invariant fails if any occurrence has the tbE-subject setting the course while the object conforms to the subject (reversed direction), OR if tbE ever means mere co-presence/accompaniment (maʿa) with no before/after ordering. No such occurrence exists — even 23:71 ("were the truth to follow their desires") keeps truth as the would-be trailer conforming to desires, preserving direction.
internal_discovery.rationale: A single non-empty residue — "coming-behind-and-along-the-track-of a preceding reference, with the trailer's course conformed to the leader" — is recoverable in every one of the 172 occurrences after subtracting form (I bare-trail / IV causative-dispatch-or-append / VIII reflexive-adherence / VI reciprocal-succession), construction (accusative reference-object, spatial adbār/āthār/khuṭuwāt/sabīl, passive = leader), participants, and context. The direction is determinate everywhere (follower behind, reference ahead) and the concrete anchor-cases (Pharaoh's pursuit, the trailing shooting-star, atbaʿa sababan, the rādifah, consecutive months, a curse made-to-trail) hold the spatial/sequential core on the surface with no inference. The large allegiance/adherence cluster is a metaphorical extension (falling in behind a guide, desire, or conjecture as if it went before one), but that bridge is densely and internally attested: the very same verb governs literal spatial trailers (khuṭuwāt "footsteps," adbār "backs," āthār "traces," sabīl/ṣirāṭ "path") in frames identical to the abstract ones, so the extension is licensed from within the data rather than imported. The reading is sharply distinct from ṭwʿ "obey" (which the text itself coordinates as a separate act) and from slk/mšy "go along a path" (which lack a preceding reference). No occurrence reverses the direction or reduces to mere accompaniment; there is no residue-absent case, so inconsistent_refs is empty and clean universal presence is claimed honestly. Strength STRONG rather than MODERATE because the spatial core is surface-recoverable in multiple pure-motion and pure-sequence anchors and the sole extension needed is internally bridged, not stipulated.

adversarial_verification.notes: Adversarial sweep of all 172 occurrences across ADJ(VI)/N/N(VIII)/V/V(IV)/V(VIII) found no genuine failing occurrence, no semantic split, and no homonymy. Every token reduces to the frozen residue: a trailing entity Y positioned behind a preceding reference X, conforming its motion/sequence/course/allegiance to it, with fixed direction (follower behind, followed ahead). Hardest cases attacked and reconciled without circularity: (1) atba'a sababan (18:85/89/92) — object is a route/means, not a self-moving leader, but a pre-existing course is traversed along its set track, so directionality holds; (2) causative form IV appending a consequence (2:262 mann, 2:263 adha, 11:60/11:99/28:42 la'na) — the appended item is caused to come-AFTER a preceding act, i.e. the causative of the same behind-relation; (3) abstract-object VIII (follow zann/hawa/batil/haqq/khutuwat/milla/ridwan) — coherent metaphorical extension (conform course to a governing reference), not a distinct sense; (4) 23:71 law ittaba'a al-haqqu ahwa'ahum — subject still conforms to object, direction intact; (5) 79:7 al-radifah / 77:17 al-akhirin / 23:44 ba'dahum ba'dan and mutatabi'ayn (4:92, 58:4) — succession one-behind-another. Distinctiveness holds: the contribution discriminates against xlf (replace/succeed), lHq (reach the same level), and even close neighbors qfw (trace footprints) and rdf (be immediately behind) — tbE's core is specifically fall-in-behind-and-conform-course/allegiance, so it is neither a vague blob nor so elastic it fits arbitrary roots. Falsification condition (a follower placed ahead of the reference, or no preceding reference at all) is clear and unmet. Verdict: SUPPORTED.
